business_summary: Sakae Electronics Corporation trades in general industrial electronic components and electronic devices in Japan. The company offers switching and variable power supply, UPS, Custom power supply, inverter, LED lighting power supply, AC adapter, transformer, heat sink, heat exchanger, noise filter, inlet, coil and inductor, fans and motors, motion control, encoder, solenoid, control, FA, and circuit breakers, digital/analog panel meter, rotating light, printed circuit board, IC socket, connector, camera link connector cable, slip ring rotary connector, terminal block, spring terminal block, capacitor, regenerative resistance, precision resistance, other various resistors, trimmer potentiometer, dial, snacks, switch, membrane switch, fuse, lightning protection, crystal oscillator, semiconductors, MOS-FET, LED, relay, sensors, fire/smoke detection device, temperature and humidity sensor, thermostat, peltier heater, temperature controller, pneumatic equipment related, room pressure control equipment, spring-loaded seals, latching and locking springs, EMI shielding, heat dissipation sheet, buzzer speaker, cables, wires, and tubes, accessories, probe, screws and springs, rack, solder, soldering iron, tool, adhesives, tapes, antistatic, recording paper, abrasive paper, insulating paper, lubricants, battery, digital signage, touch panel, LCD, OLED, PC motherboards, LCD monitors, switching HUB, HDMI and other various cables, USB, LAN, card slots, memory cards, RFID/communication module, optical and lighting, cameras, measuring instruments, remote controls, ultrasonic cleaning machine, software, ROM programmer, crimping and wire processing machines, shelves and storage, and other ICT equipment related. Its products are used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, medical equipment, broadcasting equipment, and communication equipment. Sakae Electronics Corporation was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
